moworks.notes: Cues cut on and off, no motion. Rules: ≤ 42 chars per line, ≤ 2 lines, ≤ 17–20 chars/s, each cue ≥ 20 frames at 24 fps (5/6 s) and ≤ 7 s, ≥ 2-frame gap, times snapped to frames. Demo: two sentences as cues 0.35–1.95 s and 2.03–3.6 s; text 18 px bold, white with a 3.5 px dark outline (no box), centred in the lower third. Loop 4.2 s. Params: tối đa (42 ký tự × 2 dòng) · tốc độ đọc (≤ 17–20 ký tự/s) · thời lượng (0.83–7 s) · nghỉ (2 khung). Rules: ≤ 42 characters a line, ≤ 2 lines, ≤ 17-20 characters a second, each cue 20 frames to 7 s, a gap of at least 2 frames; no motion.
